crossRefs.note: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in…
I contended with them, and cursed them, and struck certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by…
Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury…
God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But…
Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown…
‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you, your servants, and your people who enter in by…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and…

translations.web: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?
translations.bsb: Then I rebuked the nobles of Judah and asked, “What is this evil you are doing—profaning the Sabbath day?
translations.kjv: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
